findings.summary: The bridge predicate accepts any string as `bare`, so it authorizes nested identities such as `U-loop:general-review` <-> `U-loop:general-review:general-review` (and even empty <-> `:general-review`). This violates the frozen closed envelope of only a bare unit and its single `:general-review` claim, allowing a non-bare claim identity to borrow a route receipt. The added ENVELOPE test explicitly blesses these invalid pairs.
